speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when the bleeding and abdominal pain started?

speaker: Patient
text: I am at 38 weeks gestation, and the vaginal bleeding and severe abdominal pain started about an hour ago. I actually felt contractions before the bleeding began, but they stopped once the bleeding started. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: This presentation of severe abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding at 38 weeks is highly concerning for placental abruption. DIAGNOSIS READY: Placental Abruption
